# Diego Maury | Strategic Program Director

> Diego Maury is a Strategic Program Director who integrates strategy, operations, innovation, and AI-enabled systems to turn organizational complexity into executable systems. He works across corporate innovation, RevOps, process automation, and ecosystem programs in Mexico and LATAM, through fractional leadership, scoped projects, and advisory engagements.

Founder and former operator of HackSureste (innovation ecosystem, Southeast Mexico). Operated national innovation programs with HEINEKEN México and Tec de Monterrey / INCmty.

Selected metrics: 3,231 projects reached across four editions of a national open innovation program (operational estimate); +600% regional participation growth in Southeast Mexico, 2019 to 2021 (operational estimate); 400+ university students trained in one REDUX edition (verified, Tec Annual Report 2020); 3,000+ HackSureste ecosystem participants (operational estimate).

Contact: dm@diegomaury.mx
Extended profile: https://diegomaury.mx/llms-full.txt

## Case Studies

- [SOFI · FlipHouse](https://diegomaury.mx/portfolio/sofi): RevOps and AI automation; speed-to-lead reduced from 1 to 3 days to under 5 minutes
- [HEINEKEN Green Challenge](https://diegomaury.mx/portfolio/heineken-green-challenge): national open innovation program; +600% southeast participation growth (operational estimate)
- [REDUX Bootcamp](https://diegomaury.mx/portfolio/redux): 400+ university students trained in the 2020 edition (verified)
- [HackSureste](https://diegomaury.mx/portfolio/hacksureste): regional innovation ecosystem, 3,000+ participants (operational estimate)
- [Notion as editorial CMS](https://diegomaury.mx/portfolio/diego-cms): 65 bilingual pages generated per build from Notion
